title: Homer: emit Work Requests from its sources
description:
Homer needs to emit Work Requests so code pull requests can get a software-factory Verdict. Today nothing emits them.

## What it does

* a Linear Task
* a GitHub issue

## Done when

* A Linear Task, a GitHub issue and a manual request each produce a valid Work Request.
* An invalid source is refused with a clear reason.
* A Homer Work Request carries `testCommand` so the reproduce check can run.

>>> Agent notes

* Contract: `specs/integration-contracts/work-request.v1.schema.json`.
